_schema.purpose: End-to-end round-trip: event -> canonicalJSON -> Ed25519 sign -> AEAD seal -> envelope JSON. Each vector pins every intermediate step so a divergence in any layer is caught by a single test. Until attn-nnj.1.9 lands, the signature/AEAD/ciphertext/full-envelope fields are __PENDING__; the EventId and EnvelopeId derivations are filled by attn-nnj.1.8.

format.vectors[].name: Human label.
format.vectors[].inputs.roomSecret: base64url-no-pad of the 32-byte room secret feeding KDF (or just supply derived keys directly via `inputs.keys`).
format.vectors[].inputs.keys: Object with `eventKey` (base64url) — if `roomSecret` is null, use this directly.
format.vectors[].inputs.clientNonce: base64url-no-pad of 16 random bytes used for EnvelopeId derivation (null for event-shaped envelopes that use the simpler `SHA-256("envelope v2" || roomId || eventId)` form).
format.vectors[].inputs.aeadNonce: base64url-no-pad of the 24-byte XChaCha20 nonce. Pinned to keep ciphertext deterministic.
format.vectors[].inputs.createdAt: Integer ms timestamp baked into both event meta and envelope AAD.
format.vectors[].expected.eventId: Computed from canonical event bytes (filled in 1.8).
format.vectors[].expected.envelopeId: Per kind: event-kind uses simpler form; signal/snapshot use clientNonce form (filled in 1.8).
format.vectors[].expected.signature: base64url-no-pad of the Ed25519 signature over canonical event bytes (filled in 1.9).
format.vectors[].expected.aadJson: UTF-8 canonical JSON of the AAD object (filled in 1.9).
format.vectors[].expected.envelope: Full envelope JSON as it would appear in the relay's DO storage AND in `POST /v2/rooms/:roomId/envelopes` request body (kind/ids filled in 1.8; nonce/ciphertext filled in 1.9).

rules: Vectors share the canonical roomSecret = 0x11*32 (roomId = hjCfgOvsatNOUedgxhZpyw) and authorId/deviceId labels with event-id.json so the cross-vector inputs match.
EnvelopeId for kind=event uses `SHA-256("envelope v2" || roomId || eventId)[:16]`.
EnvelopeId for kind=signal/snapshot_blob uses `SHA-256("envelope v2" || roomId || deviceId || clientNonce)[:16]`.
When a vector pins a clientNonce, retries MUST reuse the same nonce so the relay can dedup.
_schema.filledBy: attn-nnj.1.8 (EventId + EnvelopeId); attn-nnj.1.9 (AEAD, signature, full envelope round-trip)

vectors.name: kind=event round-trip with simple comment_created body (envelopeId uses event-form)
kind=signal envelope (envelopeId uses clientNonce-form, fixed 0x42*16 nonce)
